notes: Input descriptions and locators are empty. The verified-title replication report supplies the focal original claim and identifies the central replication sample. URL h7jfv is an OSF file identifier, not a project node; downloaded the final report via the file listing on reference project 7qnrs. Original Table 2 prints means and significance superscripts, but no Cohen d or t statistic for this contrast; no effect size calculated. Replication describes a negative Cohen d and a corresponding 90%, but prints no numerical d; percentage not treated as d. Printed t statistic retained as available statistic with its matching p. Replication overall N=2,269 is not assigned as focal analytic n. Other reported analyses (all years and original years) not mixed with central replication. Original source cache is explicitly labelled selected parsed excerpts.
